long_description:
প্রিয় Bay Area Bangladeshi ও বাংলা ভাষাভাষী কমিউনিটির সদস্যবৃন্দ,

We are thrilled to invite you to Gollachut’s first-ever stage production — Agatha Christie’s legendary mystery thriller AND THEN THERE WERE NONE, presented in Bengali.

This production is especially meaningful to us. Our journey began in January, and almost none of us had any previous theatre or acting experience. Through countless weekend rehearsals, workshops, dedication, and lots of encouragement from one another, we built the confidence to finally bring this story to the stage.

Now, we’re ready to share our hard work with you, our Bay Area Bangla-speaking community!

🏢 Presented by 

Gollachut — a California nonprofit, 501(c)(3) approved

📅 Date: 

Sunday, NOV 1, 2026 

⏰ Time: 

1st Show: 4pm PDT

2nd Show: 7:30pm PDT

📍 Venue: 

Oak Grove High School Theater (Building I, Room I-101)

285 Blossom Hill Rd, San Jose, CA 95123

🎟️ Tickets: TBD

Come experience the mystery, suspense, and drama—and support our very first theatrical journey!

Your presence and encouragement will mean the world to us. ❤️

We can’t wait to see you at the theatre!
